summary: No writes landed. The scope guard refuses all four contract paths as outside the unit work root, including .claude/settings.json which the contract explicitly lists. Independently, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .claude/skills/ are Ruler-generated from .ruler/ (ruler.toml output_path + [skills] enabled); markless CI re-runs ruler apply and fails on drift, so direct appends would be erased by 'pnpm rules' and red in CI. Correct targets are .ruler/AGENTS.md, .ruler/claude.md, .ruler/skills/guessless/SKILL.md plus a regen. Functional check passed: claim-gate.mjs --check exits 2 on a bald claim, 0 on a hedged one, run from markless. Git status identical before and after.
